task.description:
Step 1 — root-cause diagnosis for ISS-0125 / GitHub #391.

Use `fn:search-issues` first to look for prior resolution strategies that may match. Then read the relevant source files and confirm the root-cause hypothesis already documented in docs/issues/ISS-0125.json is correct (and refine if not).

Specifically:
1. Read migrations/GBL-085_state_snapshots.sql (or whatever introduced the instance_definition_snapshots table) to confirm the FK direction and whether ON DELETE CASCADE is present.
2. Read tests/integration/helpers.zig for resetTestData() / cleanup logic — confirm the cleanup ordering vs FK direction.
3. Read the four test files listed in ISS-0125: tests/integration/iss202_merge_atomicity_test.zig, iss203_idempotency_keys_test.zig, iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig, event_store_test.zig. Confirm they each have a cleanup path that respects the new FK direction.
4. Cross-reference against scratch/WF03-gh375-20260801/test-runner-step5c/zig_test_integration.log to confirm the C23503 errors are exactly as documented (offsets 1480582, 1480767).

Produce a written diagnosis at docs/issue-reports/ISS-0125-root-cause.md (YAML format per CLAUDE.md output rules) with:
- symptom (verbatim error from log)
- root cause (file:line refs for both the FK constraint definition AND the cleanup-order violation)
- candidate fix strategies (a: ON DELETE CASCADE migration; b: reorder cleanup in helpers.zig; c: both), with a recommendation.
- acceptance criteria for the fix (concrete, testable)

Do NOT implement the fix yet. Diagnosis only.

Also write/append to docs/issues/ISS-0125.json: set `root_cause` to your refined description, set `candidate_resolution` to the recommended strategy, and set `resolution` to null (still unresolved).
acceptance_criteria: docs/issues/ISS-0125.json root_cause refined with file:line refs
Recommendation stated: ON DELETE CASCADE migration GBL-106 + cleanup reorder in helpers.zig
Acceptance criteria for fix are concrete and testable

result.summary: Diagnosed the FK source and cleanup fragility: migrations/004_definitions.sql defines NO ACTION on instance_definition_snapshots.definition_id, while bespoke cleanup swallows child-delete failures. Recommended GBL-106 ON DELETE CASCADE plus cleanup-order hardening.
